# ibee_bucket_notifications (Resource)

The event notification (webhook) rules of a bucket. Create and update replace every rule of the section (PUT); destroy deletes the section (DELETE). Import using the bucket name.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_bucket_notifications" "assets" {
  bucket_name = "my-assets"
  configs = [{
    events      = ["upload", "delete"]
    webhook_url = "https://hooks.example.com/ibee"
  }]
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bucket_name` | `string` | Required |  |
| `configs` | `list(object)` | Required | The rules, in order. |
| `configs.events` | `list(string)` | Required | Event categories, such as upload and delete. |
| `configs.filter` | `single(object)` | Optional |  |
| `configs.filter.prefix` | `string` | Optional |  |
| `configs.filter.suffix` | `string` | Optional |  |
| `configs.id` | `string` | Optional |  |
| `configs.s3_events` | `list(string)` | Read-only | S3 event names the API derives from events. |
| `configs.webhook_url` | `string` | Optional | HTTPS endpoint that receives the events. |
| `id` | `string` | Read-only |  |

## Import

Import an existing resource with the identifier shown. Review the imported plan before applying; creation-only settings and local deletion permissions cannot always be reconstructed from the API.
